mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The interaction between rising PAYEMS (indicating a strong labor market) and low UNRATE (suggesting minimal inflation pressure) creates a 'goldilocks' environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in 'goldilocks' periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month consecutive decline in INDPRO, signaling reduced industrial production, anticipates decreased corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with 2mo consecutive INDPRO decline, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in RSAFS, indicating rising retail sales, boosts investor sentiment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during the holiday season (Q4).
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window (Q4 only), or 60-day forward returns in Q4 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The combination of low FEDFUNDS (< 2.5%) and high CPIAUCSL (> 300) indicates an accommodative monetary policy amidst rising inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances with FEDFUNDS < 2.5% and CPIAUCSL > 300, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (< 3.5%) within a single month, indicating a rapidly improving labor market, surprises investors, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in rapid UNRATE drop periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint effect of increasing HOUST (housing starts) and GDPC1, signaling a broadening economic expansion, drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5%.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%), or 60-day forward returns in these periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
